title: QR Code Generator
subtitle: Create QR codes for any content
description: QR Code Generator creates QR codes for URLs, text, WiFi credentials, email addresses, phone numbers, and more. Customize colors, size, and error correction levels. Download QR codes as PNG, SVG, or PDF files. Useful for sharing links, WiFi passwords, contact information, and marketing materials.

tips: Use higher error correction levels (Q or H) for QR codes that may get damaged or dirty
Larger sizes are easier to scan from a distance
High contrast colors (dark on light) improve scanning reliability
Test your QR code with multiple devices before printing or sharing
Keep QR codes simple - complex designs can reduce scanning success
pros: Supports many QR code types beyond just URLs.
Customizable colors let you match your brand or design.
Multiple download formats work for different use cases.
Error correction levels help QR codes work even if partially damaged.
cons: Very large QR codes with high error correction can become complex and harder to scan.
Custom colors need sufficient contrast or scanning may fail.
No batch generation for creating multiple QR codes at once.
Can't generate QR codes with embedded logos or images.
bestFor: Businesses, marketers, and individuals who need QR codes for sharing information. Perfect for restaurants sharing WiFi passwords, businesses putting QR codes on marketing materials, event organizers creating tickets, and anyone who wants to make sharing links or contact info easier.
technicalVerdict: This QR code generator covers the essential features most people need. The multiple QR code types are useful - WiFi QR codes are particularly handy for businesses. Error correction levels are important for real-world use where QR codes might get dirty or damaged. The color customization is nice for branding, though users need to ensure sufficient contrast. The tool generates standard QR codes that work with any QR code scanner. For most use cases, this provides everything needed without unnecessary complexity.
